headline: HCA Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong Admissions, 2026 Outlook Revised
summary: HCA tops Q2 EPS estimates on higher admissions and revenue per admission but trims parts of its 2026 guidance as higher expenses and weaker surgical volumes weigh on results.
